title: Marketing Analytics: ShopSetu Campaigns and A/B Test
description: ShopSetu is a fictional Indian direct-to-consumer fashion and lifestyle brand running 28 paid and owned campaigns across Google, Meta, YouTube, influencers, email, WhatsApp and affiliates. The data links campaign budgets and daily spend to clicks and conversions, plus a separate 12,000-user checkout A/B test (free-shipping banner). Use it for ROAS and CAC analysis, channel comparison, attribution-style funnels and A/B test significance testing.

tables.name: ad_spend
tables.description: Daily spend, impressions and clicks per campaign and device (6 duplicate rows are deliberate).

columns.name: clicks
columns.description: Clicks recorded (matches rows in the clicks table)

columns.name: spend_inr
columns.description: Spend in INR (3 rows are 100x outliers)

tables.name: clicks
tables.description: Individual ad clicks (30 duplicate rows are deliberate).

columns.name: device
columns.description: Mobile, Desktop or Tablet (a few casing issues)

columns.name: cost_inr
columns.description: Cost of this click in INR

columns.name: revenue_inr
columns.description: Order revenue in INR (NULL for Signup and Lead)

tables.name: ab_test_results
tables.description: User-level A/B test of a free-shipping banner at checkout (Sep 2024).

columns.name: user_id
columns.description: Experiment unit (visitor), assigned once to a variant

columns.name: revenue_inr
columns.description: Revenue in INR (0 when not converted)

qualityIssues: clicks: 30 exact duplicate rows (same click_id); ad_spend: 6 exact duplicates; ab_test_results: 20 exact duplicate rows - so these ids carry no PRIMARY KEY constraint.
ab_test_results: 10 users appear in both variants (contaminated assignment) - should be removed before analysis.
clicks.city: ~3% NULL and ~7% inconsistent casing/whitespace; clicks.device: ~2% casing issues ('mobile', 'DESKTOP').
conversions.revenue_inr is NULL for Signup and Lead conversions (~10%) by design.
ab_test_results has no foreign key; it is independent of the campaign tables.
CSV only - campaigns.start_date ~15% DD-MM-YYYY; campaigns.budget_inr ~30% text like '₹12,50,000'.
CSV only - ad_spend.spend_inr ~10% text with rupee symbol; clicks.click_time ~12% DD-MM-YYYY HH:MM:SS; conversions.revenue_inr ~25% text with rupee symbol and Indian grouping.

signals: [Instructor note] Campaign 'Influencer Mega Reach Oct-24' burns the largest budget at ~2.3x normal CPC with a conversion rate ~1/8 of a normal influencer campaign - by far the worst ROAS/CAC among revenue-driving campaigns (ROAS about 0.07 vs 5-8 for Search).
[Instructor note] Email and WhatsApp have the lowest CPC and the highest conversion rate (best ROAS); Google Search is the best large-scale paid channel.
[Instructor note] Diwali windows (Oct 25-Nov 14 2023, Oct 20-Nov 3 2024) lift conversion rate by ~25%; Search/Meta Diwali campaigns are the top revenue campaigns.
[Instructor note] Awareness-objective campaigns (YouTube, Display) convert to Signup/Lead mostly and look weak on last-click revenue.
[Instructor note] Desktop converts ~35% better than mobile; Metro converts better than Tier-2.

[Instructor note] A/B test: treatment lifts conversion from ~9.5% to ~11% overall (about +1.5pp, p roughly 0.01-0.03), driven by Mobile (about +1.8pp) while Desktop shows an insignificant +0.3pp; treatment AOV is ~4% lower (free shipping cost), so revenue per user lift is smaller than conversion lift.
[Instructor note] Contaminated users, duplicates and 100x spend outliers must be cleaned before computing cost metrics or test statistics.
